title: Klippo Master Product-Specific Video Prompt Library
usage_notes:
All curated prompt templates are stored in this version-controlled GitHub JSON library and loaded by Klippo; templates are not invented randomly at runtime.,Prompt generation is text-only. No uploaded image or AI image analysis is used. Product subtype and category are inferred from words in the supplied product name or the user's selected category.,Every prompt is a complete, copy-ready block of text with its own premium four-beat storyboard. Each concept has a distinct signature action, detail shot and closing composition.,No on-screen text, captions, added logos or watermarks. Each storyboard prompt is exactly 10 seconds, vertical 9:16.,For 20-second requests, Klippo delivers two separate complete 10-second prompt texts; Part 2 begins from Part 1's held final frame and uses a complementary action rather than repeating the opening.,Templates avoid unsupported specifications, benefits, ingredients, materials, accessories and performance claims.,External video generators may interpret prompts differently; Klippo stores and selects prompts but does not guarantee the output of external generators.,Product-specific action expansion: each added prompt is tied to a category-specific action and must be skipped or simplified if the uploaded reference does not support the mechanism or interaction.,Selection rule: prefer the closest matching product subtype and action; do not use a generic action merely because it exists. If subtype is uncertain, choose a reference-safe detail showcase.

Library expansion v1.2.0: additional curated category-specific storyboards; uploaded image remains the sole source of truth, and unsupported physical actions must be replaced by detail-only camera movement.
